source.dashboard: Tec Visual Vocabulary > Visual Vocabulary > Grids
source.how: REST definition + instance JSON (setCurrentPanel W1013 on a guest instance, nothing saved)

family.name: Modern Grid with column sets
family.structure: One visualization = a stitched container node (stitchType 1 = column sets; row sets are stitchType 2) holding one template per column set. All sets share the same row attributes; each set has its own columns and metrics.

containerKeys.sdm: 2 (section display mode, same as row sets)
containerKeys.sortIndex: key of the set whose sort drives the rows
containerKeys.gridProps: { shwdgdz: false } on the demo (row-set build used shwdgdz true)
containerKeys.nf / gnf: number formats per set and metric

setKeys.rows / cols: template units; cols can include an attribute (Segment) to pivot a set's metrics under element headers
setKeys.vp.chartCfg: present only on microchart sets: HTML-escaped JSON array [{ type, n, autoName, mid:[metricId], aid:[attrId], format }]
setKeys.thresholds: keyed by metric id; used to color microchart bars per attribute element
setKeys.prop.banding_setting: XML: <EN>0</EN> banding off on the demo
setKeys.fmts.rh / ch / va: row header, column header and value formats

examples.title: Grid with Column Sets
examples.visualCues: shared row headers (Category, Subcategory with merged Category cells) then two column groups: a plain metrics group, and a group with element headers (Consumer / Corporate / Home Office) each over the same metrics

examples.title: Grid with Microcharts
examples.visualCues: rows of State; plain metric columns, then a column of small bar charts (one bar per Category) and a column of small line charts with dots (one point per Year)

sets.barColors: thresholds on Revenue by Category element override barColor: Furniture #9586BC, Office Supplies #54457A, Technology #BCB1E2

commonFormatting.rowHeaders: Open Sans 10pt, #35383A, left, white background, #EBEBEB bottom border
commonFormatting.columnHeaders: Open Sans 10pt bold, wrapped, bottom-aligned, #ABABAB bottom border
commonFormatting.page: free-form; light blue-gray background, white grids, section headings and descriptions as text boxes (same as the KPI page)

buildFromCode.helper: s.buildColumnSetGrid({ datasetId, idOf, gridKey, rows, sets, title, mergeColumnHeaders = true }) -> { gridKey, stitchedKey, setKeys }
buildFromCode.sets: [{ title, attrs, metrics } | { title, microchart: { type: 'sparkline'|'trendBar', metric, attr, format } }]

capturedActions.insertModernGrid: copyUnit K51 + Visualization off + changeGridToStitched (same start as row sets)
capturedActions.addColumnSet: copyUnit(unitKey: gridKey, toKey: container) WITHOUT stitchType (row sets use stitchType 2) + format {Title, widget/vis off} + formatGridZone + moveUnit(toKey: container, index)
capturedActions.setColumns: addUnit axis 2 on that set's template (attributes first, then metrics)
capturedActions.microchart: a column set with addUnit metric (no axis) + attribute (axis 2), then format Visualization {SelectedVisualization/ClassName 'DossierRawValueVisualizationStyle', ViewMode 51} with WidgetProps <chartCfg value="..."> (JSON double-escaped, ids prefixed '@pLd') + setWidgetString skey 'mcname'
capturedActions.mergeColumnHeaders: updateTemplate advancedProperties {'Template Formatting': {MergeColumnCells: '-1'}} on every set (Format > Layout > Column headers > Merge repetitive cells)

buildFromCode.verified: 2026-11-10: build-grids-showcase.js built both grids on Shared Studio › Business Insurance Claims Analytics in 7.1 s ('zz Grids Showcase v1' in My Reports): Region/State Code rows with a Totals set and a Customer Segment-pivoted set; State Code rows with a values set, a trendBar by Customer Segment and a sparkline by Payment Date (Quarter), sorted by Payment Amount. MergeColumnCells and set titles were then applied to the saved dashboard with the same actions the helper now sends.
buildFromCode.notYet: Per-element microchart bar colors (the demo's three thresholds on Revenue by Category element) — the build uses a single barColor.
